title: Workflow orchestration: from a fixed v1 sequence to a {{green:stateful v2 graph}}
headSub: v2 runs end to end with no interrupt() (ADR-059); SqliteSaver persists after every node; the only human decision is out-of-graph, on demand.

lanes.title: v1 - fixed sequence
lanes.sub: no shared state; a crash loses all progress

lanes.transition: v2: LangGraph stateful graph - state persisted after every node, configurable funnel width (ADR-061)
On-demand, post-run, per scored job (ADR-055/061) - out-of-graph, no graph pause

takeaway.text: State-driven execution buys HITL, error recovery, and introspection: the graph topology is testable independently of agent quality, and any scored job can be pulled deeper {{blue:on demand}} without re-running the graph.
